invariants.name: External Call Timeout
invariants.rule: Every outbound network call to data.gov.in or api.vachana.ai must enforce a strict timeout (< 3.0s) and degrade to local cached baselines without breaking the audio stream.

invariants.name: Price Precision & Provenance
invariants.rule: Any price recited over voice must explicitly state the crop variety, the unit (Rs./Quintal), and the arrival date.

invariants.name: Barge-in Latency
invariants.rule: Speech activity detected by VAD while the assistant is speaking must abort active TTS packet streaming in under 100ms.
